# Pagination

## Install

It lands in `src/rost/pagination/`, with what it needs and its contract. In an app that uses shadcn:

```sh
npx shadcn add https://rost.build/r/pagination.json
```

Then import `src/rost/fonts.css` and `src/rost/tokens.css` once, at the root of the app. More on this in [Install](../INSTALL.md).

## Anatomy

- `root`: A `<nav aria-label="Pagination">`: the back button, where you are, the forward button, 8px apart.
- `previous`: An IconButton, Secondary, with its own arrow-left. Disabled on the first page.
- `label`: "Page 3 of 12" in paragraph type, the secondary text colour, 8px clear of the buttons.
- `next`: An IconButton, Secondary, with Rost's arrow-right Icon. Disabled on the last page.

## When to use

- **Long lists.** Invoices, transactions, clients: anything longer than a screen where the order matters and people go back and forth.

## When not to use

- **Short lists.** Under fifty rows, show them all.
- **Feeds.** Something people scroll through once. Load more as they reach the end.

## Behaviour

Back, where you are, forward. I left out page numbers to jump to: in the apps people go one page at a time, and "Page 3 of 12" says enough. The buttons are disabled at either end.

## Accessibility

- **Element**: `<nav aria-label="Pagination">`, with two IconButtons labelled Previous page and Next page.
- **Name**: The buttons by what they do. The label says where you are, and `aria-live` reads the new page when it changes.
- **Keyboard**: Tab reaches the buttons; Enter or Space turns the page.
- **Colour**: The label is 11:1 on the dark page.

## Content

"Page 3 of 12", in numbers.
